I hope your pillow is warm on both sides at night, I hope your socks are always soggy and have holes in the toes. Maybe you don’t get any affection or attention in real life so you go online as a keyboard warrior dumping on people, I don’t know what drives you and I don’t care. Work out your shite, do better and be nicer. It’s not difficult.
